svg.title: The ranker: five attention blocks of width 192 over the user's history and the candidates of the feed, 2.1 million parameters

cc:Work.dc:title: The ranker: five attention blocks of width 192 over the user's history and the candidates of the feed, 2.1 million parameters
cc:Work.dc:description: Box-and-arrow diagram in two columns. Left: the user vector and up to 256 history events become a user token and history tokens of width 192, encoded by one self-attention block. Right: up to 300 candidates per feed become a dense block of 104 columns and a candidate token of width 192; a retrieval step adds values from the 16 nearest history items; two pairs of blocks follow, each a cross-attention block and a self-attention block over the candidates; a score head gives one score per candidate and an auxiliary head, used in training only, predicts the display order.
